notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.30
notes.notes:
General Changes and Fixes:


 Fixed the gems upgrades not working/saving
 Fixed bug where going from one stage to another would crash your game
 Made the flamethrower do more damage over time
 Made the flamethrower hitbox come out quicker
 Increased performance in relation to particles
 Fixed screen shake issue when returning to the main menu
 Boss battle(s) have a fixed difficulty and can’t be changed
 The final level now only needs 10 more trophies from the previous level instead of [strike]20[/strike]
 Now when you have the option to go to the next level and its a boss level, the “Next Stage” button will show in purple and immediately take you to the boss when selected


Gameplay Changes:


 Improved climbing physics
 Ability to jump off of vines/ladders while climbing them
 Ability to latch onto vines/ladders by going down them first
 Switched the ‘B’ button on bombs to ‘R’ for convenience


New Features:


 Added new achievements
 Added new levels
 Added the ability to enable/disable the crown trail in the options menu
 Added the ability to enable/disable the reload bar in the options menu
 Added particle effects for spawned enemies and respawned enemies

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.21
notes.notes:
General Changes and Fixes:


 Fixed a bug where you wouldn’t be able to throw certain weapons after some time playing
 Updated the stage icons for the respected stages
 Decreased the price of powerups in the item shop
 Fixed a bug where stage 3 wouldn’t start on medium/hard difficulty
 Decreased the damage of safety bombs from [strike]3[/strike] ... 1

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.20
notes.notes:
General Changes and Fixes:


 New UI elements in the item shop to indicate where the next/back arrows go
 "The Ancient One" has been changed from human to spirit and has taken over a new look
 New billboards in the tutorial to further explain how to progress in the game
 Amount of gems received from max gem upgrades: [strike]+1[/strike] ... +3
 When pressing [SPACE] during dialogue, instead of going to the next sentence, it will finish the current sentence, and then pressing [SPACE] again will trigger the next sentence
 Sound fixes for the wall climb/slide


Gameplay Changes:


 You will now be able to access every area of the map without needing the ability to dash
 The base dash now travels slightly longer before stopping


New Features:


 New achievements for every level and their difficulty 
 You will now be able to both climb and slide on walls instead of previously only being able to slide
 You will now be able to go to the next level and choose the next level difficulty instead of going to the main menu
 You will now be able to change the difficulty of the current level and redo it after completing it instead of going to the main menu
 When you unlock a weapon, you will now be prompted with a notification in the top-right of your screen that tells you which weapon you unlocked
 When in dialogue, you will be able to see their character icon next to the dialogue bubble
 When you attack, you'll have a bar over your heard that indicates how long until you'll be able to attack again

notes.title: WEAPONS KNIGHT RELEASE! 8/20/21
notes.notes:
Trapped and wanting to overthrow the cursed ruler, with a multitude of weapons at your disposal and a fleet of enemies that stop you from progressing, you'll have to fight your way through various terrains to then overthrow the wretched king and claim back what was once yours.

Weapons Knight is releasing on the 20th of August!
